note: Quality floors for the anti-rot guardrail. Every value ratchets UP as code lands; a floor may only be LOWERED via an ADR in docs/decisions/. minCoverage is a percentage (0-100); minFixtures is a count; lastVerified is an ISO-8601 date (or null until a real fixture is captured and verified).

chatgpt.note: Includes Browser-plugin live conversation fixtures for code and writing-block/source behavior, plus an access-gate fixture from agent-browser.

claude.note: Includes signed-in Browser-plugin live fixtures for code and document-artifact behavior, plus access/login-gate fixtures.

gemini.note: Includes unauthenticated live conversation fixtures for code and source/generated-file behavior.

grok.note: Free-submit signup gate fixture only; authenticated conversation DOM still required before parser implementation.

meta.note: Free-submit login gate fixture only; authenticated conversation DOM still required before parser implementation.
